Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Thanks for your time. Can you walk me through how you deal with your energy account?

Speaker: Tom Bright
Text: I pay by direct debit and mostly ignore it, if I'm honest. My partner used to do it but now it's me.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: Tell me about the last bill you looked at closely.

Speaker: Tom Bright
Text: In the spring we got a bill for three hundred pounds more than usual. It was estimated. I rang them and sat on hold for forty minutes. They told me to send a reading and they'd recalculate.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: That must have been frustrating, right?

Speaker: Tom Bright
Text: I took a picture of the meter with the date showing on my phone, because I didn't trust them to believe me. I sent the reading online and emailed the photo too. The new bill came a week later and it was fine.

Speaker: Jordan Ellis
Text: How do you usually remember to send readings?

Speaker: Tom Bright
Text: I don't, really. The reminder emails go to my partner's address, so I never see them.
